zh-CN.name: Watchless（DesireCore 维护版）
zh-CN.shortDesc: 将授权视频转为截图笔记和 HTML/PDF/ZIP。完整流程需要 macOS、Python 3.10+、ffmpeg/ffprobe、Pandoc、Poppler 和 Chrome/Chromium，YouTube 输入另需 yt-dlp 和 Node.js。可使用已有字幕或本地 Whisper；腾讯云和火山引擎转写需自备账号、凭据及费用，并在上传前确认。浏览器 Cookie 默认关闭。

en-US.name: Watchless (DesireCore fork)
en-US.shortDesc: Turn authorized video into screenshot-led notes and HTML/PDF/ZIP. The full workflow needs macOS, Python 3.10+, ffmpeg/ffprobe, Pandoc, Poppler and Chrome/Chromium. YouTube input also needs yt-dlp and Node.js. Use existing subtitles or local Whisper, or approve Tencent Cloud or Volcengine upload with your own account, credentials and billing. Browser cookies are off by default.
